purpose: Source-pinned comparison references for evidence-directed scientific discovery. Records describe external publications/leaderboards; none are Symthaea or Symtropy results.
global_rules: Do not pool scores across benchmarks: task units, harnesses, graders, budgets and outcomes differ.
Separate official benchmark reproduction from custom adapters and synthetic controls.
Record exact benchmark version, model/harness, task set, run count, confidence intervals, failures and budget before making a superiority claim.
A provider-reported benchmark score is not an independent multi-provider leaderboard unless independent reproduction is available.

benchmarks.name: Autonomous Science Bench
qualification_notes: A campaign resolves only when both discovery and learning gates pass.
Only three trials per task in the v0.1 pilot; benchmark authors caution that the 5.5-point leader gap is not statistically meaningful.
These are model+harness system results, not model-only capabilities.
Official v0.1 task set differs from extra tasks appearing in the upstream repository README.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Primary external Stage-B/closed-loop benchmark; use #10921 / PR #10947. Current Nuclease+Propylene adapter is a pilot, not full six-task reproduction.

benchmarks.name: BioBasicsBench
qualification_notes: Provider-reported OpenAI/Ligo evaluation, not an independent multi-provider leaderboard.
Public release announcement does not provide a third-party runnable task and grader package; direct reproduction is not claimed.
The task families include raw gels/blots, plate images, microscopy, instrument outputs, quantification and insufficient-evidence recognition.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Complementary evidence-interpretation scorecard; do not claim reproduction until task/rubric access is available. Use BIABench for open replication.

benchmarks.name: BIABench
qualification_notes: Outcome and process/QC scores are distinct and must not be collapsed.
Process score is not a correctness proxy: it has weak correlation with outcome.
Evaluation data are explicitly evaluation-only; do not train/fine-tune on evaluation.zip or re-host archives; preserve the canary.
The paper's run protocol uses v1.0, basic instructions, three runs per agent/task pair and its stated process judge.
Per-source dataset licenses still apply.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Open reproducible evidence-interpretation benchmark; issue #13473. Internal confirmatory extension should use at least 10 runs/task and report every denominator.

benchmarks.name: LABBench2

metrics.secondary: tool/harness execution and evidence subskill performance

qualification_notes: Broad biology research task suite; not a full multi-round laboratory campaign or raw-image analysis benchmark.
Keep task-family and subtask scores separate.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Complementary knowledge/evidence/task competence scorecard; use exact dataset and harness revisions.

benchmarks.name: SciWorkBench
qualification_notes: Score describes a model-plus-harness system, not a base-model capability constant.
Task procedures, multimodal evidence and scientific self-correction are distinct failure modes.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Full workflow comparator; require exact task/harness and budget match.

benchmarks.name: FIRE-Bench

task_scope.primary: rediscover published findings with experimental design, execution and evidence-backed conclusion

qualification_notes: High run-to-run variance; report repeated trials and outcome calibration.
Not directly comparable to EGB numerical residuals or AS-Bench resolution.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: End-to-end rediscovery comparator; match benchmark version, harness and costs.

benchmarks.name: AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard
qualification_notes: Historical 3% all-requirements perfect-completion result must not be conflated with later partial-completion rubric scores or leaderboard snapshots.
Reproduce the exact grader and benchmark snapshot before any current comparison.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: End-to-end deliverable comparator; report perfect completion and partial rubric score separately.

benchmarks.name: NewtonBench

metrics.primary: interactive law recovery under counterfactual shifts, probes, complexity and noise

qualification_notes: Tool assistance can sometimes induce premature exploitation; tool access must be an ablation, not an assumed benefit.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Stage-A/Stage-B action-selection and mechanistic discovery benchmark.

benchmarks.name: Phases of Rotating Black Objects in d=5 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Theory

metrics.primary: background branch, extremal near-horizon attractor consistency, charges and thermodynamics

qualification_notes: Same background symmetry class is a closer physical comparator than generic high-curvature solver benchmarks.
A matching background branch does not validate Symtropy's spin-2 response operator, its derivatives, or endpoint Gram metrics.
Published scan is not an exact machine-readable benchmark or proof of branch completeness.
benchmarks.symthaea_mapping: Primary physical reproduction/coverage comparator for the equal-spin EGB background; separate from response-map and agent-intelligence scorecards.

prohibited_aggregations: Do not average AS-Bench resolution, BIABench outcome/process, BioBasicsBench reward, SciWorkBench mean, FIRE-Bench F1 and EGB residuals into a composite SOTA score.
Do not equate a low physics residual with scientific-agent competence.
Do not equate a high process score with correct scientific measurements.
Do not equate high expected information gain with positive decision value.
Do not treat a provider-reported model leaderboard as an independent external replication.
